summary: Phase 3 (Per-Truck P&L, Rented Ledger, Monthly PDF export) end-to-end PASSED. Backend: 14/14 new pytest cases in test_phase3.py green — includes exact math for KA-XX-1288 (revenue 40000 - cost 8000 - emi 8840 - shared_share 0 = net 23160, per_trip = net/trips), sort desc by net_contribution, idle Own vehicles net == -emi with shared_share=0; rented ledger balance math (12500 then -1800), running_outstanding accumulated per owner in chronological order (12500 -> 10700) with entries returned newest-first, /summary sorted by outstanding desc and equal to 10700 for the isolated owner, owner_driver auto-fill from vehicle.owner_name on POST, DELETE removes; PDF endpoint returns 200 with content-type application/pdf and body starts with %PDF, and specifically handles en-dash \u2013 in category names without 500; all 4 endpoints return 401 without Bearer. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, token injected via evaluate on /login then reload): /more shows more-vehicle-pnl / more-rented-ledger / more-annual; /vehicle-pnl renders month bar (Aug 2026), note line 'Net = revenue + adj - trip cost - EMI - share of overheads', 10 vehicle cards with green (₹23,160 for KA-XX-1288) and red (-₹3,318, -₹15,070 for idle Own vehicles) nets — expanding the KA-XX-1288 card shows Revenue ₹40,000 / Return ₹0 / Trip cost -₹8,000 / EMI -₹8,840 / Overhead ₹0 / Net ₹23,160 breakdown; vpnl-prev/vpnl-next navigate months. /rented-ledger shows Total-owed ₹10,700 card, per-owner card (Manju M ₹10,700, 2 trips paid ₹28,000), R2 entry (-₹1,800 run ₹10,700) above R1 (₹12,500 run ₹12,500) confirming newest-first; rl-add opens modal with 4 rl-veh-* chips + rl-field-* inputs + rl-save — created and then deleted a test entry successfully (rl-del handled). /pnl shows BOTH export-excel-btn AND export-pdf-btn. Only pre-existing cosmetic RN-web deprecation warnings (props.pointerEvents) — no red screen, no functional bugs.

react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents deprecation warning still appears on web preview (carry-over from iter 2/3, non-blocking). Migrate to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Migrate remaining props.pointerEvents usages to style.pointerEvents (carry-over).
critical_code_review_comments: vehicle_pnl correctly implements net = revenue + return_adj - trip_cost - emi - shared_share; shared_share is prorated by trips share (n/total_trips), so a vehicle with 0 trips has shared_share=0 -> net == -emi. Verified numerically for KA-XX-1288 with an isolated month.

rented_ledger sort key uses (date, created_at) for the running-outstanding pass then reverses to newest-first for the response — this correctly separates 'chronological running accumulation' from 'newest-first display'.
rented_ledger balance formula: revenue_to_pay - commission_adj - amount_paid; matches spec. Summary uses same formula per-owner and sorts desc by outstanding.
POST /rented-ledger auto-fills owner_driver from vehicle.owner_name only if not provided; DELETE is idempotent (delete_one, returns {ok:true}).

pdf/monthly correctly transliterates en-dash / em-dash / smart quotes to latin-1 via _s() helper before rendering with FPDF (Helvetica core font). Verified end-to-end with a TEST_ category containing \u2013.

Small potential improvement (not a bug): overhead_alloc = emi + shared_share is only displayed as a single 'overhead_alloc' number; the frontend currently splits EMI vs overhead_share in the breakdown UI so this is fine, just worth noting.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 Phase 3 + all previous 27 regression + 9 Phase 2 remain green)
